items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of QB Jacoby Brissett to Ravens; expected complete this weekend, debut Week 10 vs LAC. Not in time for TNF vs JAX.
items.why: Fills void after Jackson thumb IR and Huntley season-ending toe.
items.implication: Stabilizes BAL QB room post-Jackson; more traditional pocket passer volume.
items.opportunity: Ravens pass catchers see higher attempt volume long-term.

items.text: BAL loses Lamar Jackson, likely for the season due to thumb injury requiring surgery and IR placement. Huntley also season-ending toe.
items.why: Thumb injury on first snap vs BUF, surgery needed per coach.
items.implication: Ravens turn to rookie Fagnano short-term then Brissett; pass volume up potential, Henry/Flowers/Andrews roles shift.
items.opportunity: Increased pass attempts under backup QBs; monitor Brissett volume.

items.text: Simplest bull case for Ravens pass game with Brissett is less efficiency mitigated by more volume. Lamar 35+ attempts only 15% of starts; Brissett 47%.
items.why: Career attempt rates show Brissett throws more frequently.
items.implication: BAL WRs/TEs get more opportunities despite lower efficiency.
items.opportunity: Higher target volume for Flowers, Andrews, Likely under Brissett.

items.text: Levitan and Silva on Seattle’s backfield with Charbonnet and Jadarian Price returns: gonna be like Charbonnet/Walker expect with worse versions of the players.
items.why: Returns create committee similar to prior Walker/Charbonnet.
items.implication: Neither Price nor Charbonnet full lead; Walker still key if healthy.
items.opportunity: Avoid overvaluing either as solo RB1; handcuff both.

items.text: Nick Bosa returns to practice. RB Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) and WR Mike Evans won’t go today. Aiyuk not an option.
items.why: Practice report: CMC hamstring, Evans Achilles-related.
items.implication: Monitor Friday; CMC limited risk, Evans questionable availability.
items.opportunity: SF backups or game-script shifts if limited.

items.text: AJ Brown misses another game due to lingering knee/ankle issue.
items.implication: NE WR depth or Diggs/others elevated; Maye targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Handcuff or waiver targets in NE receiving corps.

items.text: Wheels completely fall off for IND, Jonathan Taylor saga continues amid team fire sale and trades.
items.why: IND selling assets, slow pace, poor team performance.
items.implication: JT value volatile ROS; potential trade elevates elsewhere or tanks IND offense.
items.opportunity: Monitor trade destinations for role upgrade; IND handcuffs if stays.

items.text: Waiver note: Mike Washington handed LV workhorse role with 25-2 carry edge over Ashton Jeanty in Week 8. Stickiness TBD.
items.implication: Jeanty role reduced; monitor if temporary.
items.opportunity: Washington as waiver/handcuff priority if available.

items.text: Cowboys WR routes on 38 Dak dropbacks: CeeDee Lamb 29, Ryan Flournoy 26, George Pickens 25, Mingo 7. Plenty of 2-TE even with Ferguson hurt.
items.why: Actual route counts show near-even distribution.
items.implication: Pickens not clearly WR2; Flournoy involvement real.
items.opportunity: Lamb still lead but targets split; monitor for changes.
items.conflict: Jones comments on needing Pickens more

items.text: Up in pace: DAL @ IND. Slow paced slogs: HOU @ LAC. Full Week 9 Snaps & Pace notes.
items.why: Neutral pace and totals favor high-play game for DAL-IND.
items.implication: Higher snap/opportunity environment for skill players.
items.opportunity: Stack or elevate DAL/IND skill in volume spots.

items.text: Yes, I am KEEPING IT OPEN on Ladd McConkey this week. As a WR3. Let’s not get carried away.
Did Jerry Jones say George Pickens needs the ball more? Yes. Does that change anything for fantasy football? Not really.
items.why: Coach comments don't override actual route/target data.
items.implication: No material upgrade; stick to usage.
items.conflict: Coach talk vs even routes with Lamb/Flournoy

items.text: Trevor Lawrence only QB9 in fantasy PPG. Would be far higher if Jaguars weren't playing so well. Passing by quarter: heavy early, drops in 4th as they protect leads.
items.why: Quarter-by-quarter attempt/yard/TD split shows early volume then game management.
items.implication: Ceiling capped in blowouts; better in close games.
items.opportunity: Positive game script vs weak defenses boosts him.

items.text: Zach Charbonnet or Jadarian Price for the rest of the season? Give me CHARB!
items.implication: Price lower ROS priority than Charbonnet.
items.opportunity: Prefer Charb if both available; Price as deep stash.
